promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: The AQA 'Conflict and tension' topic covering the First World War spans which years?
questions.explain: The AQA specification covers conflict and tension from 1894 to 1918.

questions.q: On which date did the major British offensive at the Battle of the Somme begin in 1916?
questions.explain: The Battle of the Somme began on 1 July 1916, with nearly 60,000 British casualties on the first day.

questions.q: The 1916 Battle of Verdun was fought between Germany and which other country?
questions.explain: Verdun in 1916 was a prolonged battle of attrition between Germany and France.

questions.q: In which year did the United States enter the First World War on the side of the Allies?
questions.explain: The USA entered the war in 1917, boosting Allied manpower and resources.

questions.q: What term describes the policy of building up armed forces and glorifying military power before 1914?
questions.explain: Militarism, the build-up and glorification of armed forces, was a key long-term cause of the war.

questions.q: Which new weapon was first used by the British at the Battle of the Somme in 1916?
questions.explain: Tanks were first deployed by the British during the Battle of the Somme in 1916.

questions.q: The system of opposing European alliances before 1914 chiefly pitted the Triple Entente against which bloc?
questions.explain: The Triple Entente (Britain, France, Russia) opposed the Triple Alliance (Germany, Austria-Hungary, Italy).

questions.q: Which 1917 battle is also known as the Third Battle of Ypres and is notorious for its mud?
questions.explain: Passchendaele (the Third Battle of Ypres) in 1917 became infamous for fighting in thick mud.

questions.q: Which gas was first used on a large scale by the Germans at Ypres in 1915?
questions.explain: Chlorine gas was first used en masse at the Second Battle of Ypres in 1915.

questions.q: Which 1914 battle halted the German advance and led to the entrenchment of the Western Front?
options: The First Battle of the Marne
questions.explain: The First Battle of the Marne in September 1914 stopped the German advance and began trench warfare.

questions.q: Whose assassination in Sarajevo in June 1914 triggered the outbreak of the First World War?
questions.explain: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand, heir to Austria-Hungary, set off the July Crisis of 1914.

questions.q: What was the name of the German plan to defeat France quickly before turning to fight Russia?
questions.explain: The Schlieffen Plan aimed to knock out France via Belgium before Russia could fully mobilise.
